# dsh-quote-reply
Quote & reply for DeepSeek Harness, the way Claude Code does it.
中文 · DSH 0.2.x
Select text → answer it in a popover → the pair becomes a block above the composer → send them all a
text → answer it in a popover → the pair becomes a block above the composer → send them all at once.
## Features

- Selection pill, reply popover, `Enter` to add.
- 76×76 blocks: two quote lines with a rule, two li

nes of your answer.
- Composer text stays yours; it lands last in the message.
- Images in the draft

travel with the message.
- Real quote rules in the transcript, not `│` characters.
- Chinese and En
glish, following the app language.
## Install
Requires DSH 0.2.x with the desktop/web conversation UI.

- **npm** → `dsh plugin add dsh-quote-reply`
- **Plugin Manager** → *Add plugin* → this directory.
-
**Git** → `plugin_manager install_bundle target: git+https://github.com/gf691271/dsh-quote-reply#<c

ommit>`
- **Market index** → add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gf691271/dsh-quote-reply/main/ma
et index** → add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gf691271/dsh-quote-reply/main/market/index.json`
## Usage

1. Select text in any message.
2. Click `Quote Text`, write your answer, press `Enter`.
3. Repeat, t
hen press `Enter` in the composer (or click **Send**).
## Notes

- `│` at the start of a line is the storage marker; the transcript renders it as a rule.
- A send th

e host refuses keeps your blocks and text; nothing is lost.
- File attachments (PDF, zip) cannot rid
e a quote and stop the send with a notice.
If this saved you a few clicks, a ⭐ helps other people find it.
